text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report outlines the results of an investigation into installing speed humps on Wall Avenue, between Langside Avenue and Portage Avenue. The results indicate that the criteria to justify installing speed humps are not satisfied.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Did NOT authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Wall Avenue, between Langside Avenue and Portage Avenue.
